name: mr-tapioca
description: Mr. Tapioca — boba focus app. Web app + Capacitor iOS shell (with a native Screen Time blocker).

scripts.copyweb: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css app.js sw.js manifest.json www/ && cp -R assets www/assets
scripts.ios:sync: npm run copyweb && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
